nodes.label: Next.js Agent Rules
nodes.rationale: This Next.js version has breaking changes — APIs, conventions, and file structure may differ from training data. Agents must read the relevant local guide before writing code and heed deprecation notices. The block is regenerated by next dev; removing it from a diff only recreates an uncommitted change, so committing it keeps the tree clean.
